Backend Software Engineer — Acme Corp

Location: New York, NY (Hybrid)
Seniority: New Grad

About the role:
Acme is hiring a backend engineer to build APIs and services that power our product.
You will work across the stack of internal services, ship features with product
partners, and improve reliability.

Requirements:
- Experience with Python, Go, or Java
- Familiarity with REST APIs and relational databases
- Comfortable with Git, code review, and automated tests
- Strong communication skills

Preferred:
- Internship experience at a product company
- Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS/GCP)
- Interest in developer tooling

Domain: backend product engineering
